name: New York Woodworking
old_description: New York Woodworking is dedicated to designing, fabricating and creating the finishing touches that make your home special to you.
about:
Based in Ronkonkoma, New York, New York Woodworking operates as a custom woodworking shop specializing in architectural millwork and cabinetry. The company focuses on designing, fabricating, and installing finishing details for residential and commercial spaces.

The shop produces a range of millwork including custom cabinetry for kitchens, dining rooms, and bathrooms; entertainment centers and built-ins; archways, moldings, coffered ceilings, wainscot paneling, and mantles. It also offers commercial millwork packages. The work encompasses design through fabrication, with services packaged for new construction and remodeling projects.

Customers include homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors seeking tailored woodwork for interior spaces. Projects referenced on the company’s site span kitchen and bath renovations, dining room installations, and commercial fit-outs, indicating a client base across residential remodeling and light commercial construction.

The firm states its dedication to creating the finishing touches that make a home special to the owner, emphasizing attentiveness and professionalism throughout the project lifecycle.

name: New Yorker Electronics
about:
New Yorker Electronics was established in 1948 in Northvale, New Jersey, initially serving the New York, New Jersey, and Connecticut area with a focus on capacitors. The company was incorporated in 1958 under the guidance of Abe Slivka and has remained family-owned since.

Today, New Yorker Electronics operates as an international distributor of electronic components, offering capacitors, resistors, semiconductors, connectors, filters, inductors, embedded solutions, power management products, and electromechanical devices. The company holds AS9120B and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and functions as a certified franchise distributor for nearly 100 manufacturers, including Vishay, Exxelia, and Cornell Dubilier Electronics. It operates in strict accordance with AS5553 and AS6496 standards to prevent counterfeit parts.

The company serves military, aerospace, and defense sectors, supplying the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of Justice, Navy, and major contractors such as Lockheed Martin, GE, Honeywell, General Dynamics, and BAE Systems. It is also a member of the Electronics Component Industry Association (ECIA) and the Electronic Resellers Association International (ERAI).

New Yorker Electronics differentiates itself by maintaining heightened military and aerospace performance levels across its operations and by implementing rigorous anti-counterfeit standards (AS5553 and AS6496) into everyday practices.

name: New life medicals USA inc
old_description: NewLife Medicals is One Stop Solution for all your Pharmaceutical needs.
about:
New Life Medicals USA Inc is based in Efland, North Carolina. The company describes itself as a pharmaceutical supplier originating from India, where it operates as NewLife Medicals Pvt Ltd, though the founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed.

The firm provides a range of pharmaceutical sourcing and supply chain services, including reference listed drug (RLD) and comparator drug sourcing, biosimilars, specialty and branded generics procurement, REMS access, clinical trial ancillary supplies, global storage and distribution, named patient drug supplies, orphan drugs, and finished dosage forms. It operates a GDP-compliant warehouse and offers logistics services using IATA- and ADR-certified air and road transport, as well as qualified person (QP) release services. No facility size, headcount, or volume metrics are published.

Its customers include pharmaceutical sponsors, clinical trial operators, and organizations seeking comparator drugs for studies, named patient import programs, and orphan drug sourcing. The company also serves the nutraceutical market with specialized products.

New Life Medicals states its mission is to enable longer, healthier lives through responsible pharmaceutical sourcing and to help companies maximize performance across the value chain for generics, branded drugs, biosimilars, and orphan drugs. It highlights its Great Place To Work certification and EcoVadis Silver Sustainability Rating as reflections of its workplace culture and responsible business practices.

name: NewGem Foods
old_description: Sign up for our mailing list and be the first to know about promotions, events, and new product releases.
about:
NewGem Foods operates from Allyn, Washington, where it produces a line of plant-based wraps. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it describes itself as the original creator of 100% plant-based wraps designed to replace bread, tortillas, and seaweed in sushi.

The product range includes sandwich wraps and sushi wraps made from vegetables and fruits such as tomato, carrot, mango, kale, and apple. Each wrap is formulated to be gluten-free, low in calories (25–45 per wrap), and to deliver a full serving of fruit or vegetables. The wraps are produced using non-GMO, identity-preserved soybeans and carry a patented formulation. No facility size, headcount, or production volumes are published.

The wraps are sold direct to consumers through the company’s Shopify store and through retail partners including Whole Foods and Wegmans, as well as to restaurants that have featured them for years. The company markets to home cooks, sushi enthusiasts, and health-conscious shoppers looking for bread alternatives.

NewGem Foods positions its wraps as a way to reduce food waste, noting that bread and tortillas are among the largest contributors to global food waste. The patented, colorful wraps are intended to add flavor and nutrition while eliminating the need for traditional grain-based carriers.

old_description: For the best experience on our site, be sure to turn on Javascript in your browser.
about:
NewYork Cables operates from Saddle Brook, New Jersey, where it has supplied networking infrastructure for over 19 years. The company was founded with a single goal: to make quality networking simple and accessible for businesses and IT professionals.

The product line centers on bulk Ethernet cables — Cat5e, Cat6, and Cat6a in both plenum and riser ratings — alongside multimode and singlemode fiber optic cables. The catalog also includes keystone jacks, patch panels, wall plates, RJ45 connectors, and fiber optic patch cords. Every item undergoes strict quality testing before shipment. In the past 12 months the company has processed more than 20,000 orders and serves over 1.3 million customers across all 50 states.

Customers span residential, commercial, and industrial networking projects, with a strong presence in data-center installations and CCTV or professional surveillance systems. The company also supports IT network integrators and contractors who need certified cabling that passes Fluke testing and meets TIA standards.

NewYork Cables emphasizes its industry expertise, broad product range, and a reported 95 percent customer satisfaction rate. The firm highlights same-day shipping on stocked items, flexible payment options, and dedicated technical support as key differentiators.

name: Newberg Steel and Fabrication, Inc.
old_description: Newberg Steel and Fabrication has been family-owned since 1951 and takes pride in our workmanship. Our experience ensures that we do the job right the first time.
about:
Newberg Steel and Fabrication, Inc. has operated from Newberg, Oregon since its founding in 1951. The company remains family-owned, carrying forward a legacy of steel fabrication and processing that spans more than seven decades. While the original founders are not named in public records, the business has maintained continuous operation in the Willamette Valley region.

The shop provides steel fabrication, processing, construction, and manufacturing services. Capabilities include cutting, forming, and welding of plate, sheet, and pipe, along with a self-service area where customers can purchase remnants and cut-offs at discounted prices. The company also supplies trailer parts as part of its product line. Specific facility size, employee count, and annual volume figures are not publicly disclosed.

Customers span industrial, commercial, residential, and agricultural sectors. The firm serves contractors, manufacturers, farmers, and homeowners needing structural steel, trailer components, or custom-fabricated parts. Its product inventory includes trailer parts, steel plate, sheet, and pipe in various sizes.

Family ownership and a focus on workmanship are cited as the company's foundation. The business emphasizes getting the job right the first time, a principle attributed to its long-standing experience in the steel trade. The self-service remnant yard offers a practical differentiator for smaller projects and cost-conscious buyers.

name: Newport Industries, LLC
old_description: 💡 From Blueprint to Build: How Custom Fabrication is Transforming Modern Architecture
about:
Newport Industries, LLC operates from West Branch, Iowa, as a family‑owned small business. The company does not publish a founding date, but notes that its team brings 100 years of combined experience in metal design, fabrication, and machining. Ownership remains with the founding family, and the business emphasizes hands‑on craftsmanship across every project.

The shop provides design, engineering, fabrication, machining, and artistic metalwork capabilities under one roof. It functions as an original equipment manufacturer, producing three proprietary lines: Industrial Pulley Puller hydraulic gear pullers for maintenance departments, Newport Car Wash stainless‑steel parts and accessories for self‑service car washes, and Newport Living architectural metal products such as TV mounts. Contract manufacturing services are also offered for outside clients.

Primary markets include the self‑service car wash industry, which receives rugged, all‑weather stainless components, and industrial maintenance teams that use the hydraulic pullers to remove frozen gears, bearings, and couplings. Custom fabrication work serves architectural and interior‑design projects, while the OEM lines are sold directly to end users and distributors.

Leadership frames the company’s differentiation around its family‑owned structure and the depth of combined experience, stating that every job—large or small—receives the same focus on quality and expert craftsmanship. The business was built to keep design through final fabrication in house, allowing tighter control over tolerances and finish.

about:
Newtown Apparel Company operates from Newtown, Connecticut, providing custom embroidery, screen printing, and promotional product services to businesses, schools, and teams. The company does not disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founders in the available materials.

The shop handles the full decoration workflow in-house: clients request a quote, the team refines artwork and sends a proof, then production runs on embroidery and screen-printing equipment before orders ship or are picked up. The company promotes access to thousands of blank styles from brands such as Under Armour, Nike, Adidas, Eddie Bauer, Carhartt, Yeti, and Callaway, and advertises a typical turnaround of one to two weeks, with rush options available. It also sets up and manages online company stores for recurring orders.

Customers include corporate buyers sourcing giveaways for trade shows, school and youth-sports programs ordering spiritwear, and local organizations needing team uniforms. The site notes the company has helped hundreds of organizations through the guided quote-to-delivery process.

Newtown Apparel emphasizes a "no-hassle" model that combines a dedicated account contact, free artwork assistance, and free online-store setup so clients can move from idea to finished goods without managing multiple vendors.

name: Nexus Power
old_description: From Manufacturer to Engineered Solutions: A Unique Sales Approach
about:
Nexus Power is based in South Salt Lake, Utah, and operates as a manufacturer’s representative and engineered-solutions provider across 11 Western states. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure, but it presents itself as a collaborative organization built around five distinct divisions.

The firm’s five divisions—Utility/Renewables, Industrial, Commercial, Stock & Flow, and OEM—each maintain a dedicated director, a focused sales strategy, and local inside and outside sales teams. This structure allows Nexus Power to offer both technical sales representation and, through its Stock & Flow division, inventory management and product fulfillment. The company emphasizes a cross-divisional knowledge-sharing model that it says delivers innovative solutions for its partners.

Nexus Power serves customers in the utility, renewable energy, industrial, commercial, and original-equipment-manufacturer sectors. Its case studies reference work with manufacturers, distributors, and end users, indicating a broad customer base that spans the electrical power equipment supply chain.

The company states that its divisional model redefines the traditional manufacturer’s rep role by combining deep vertical expertise with the ability to leverage insights across markets. It positions this collaborative approach as its primary differentiator, aiming to exceed partner expectations through consistent support and engineered solutions.
